acceptance_criteria.criterion: The two unpublished drafts are published or cancelled with a stated reason
dr-followup-start-reported-callers is reopened or its 4 criteria are stamped with real evidence
The 32 one-short rows are each closed on merge evidence or restated in writing
The 269 never-started rows are re-parented to a successor epic, not bulk-cancelled, and the re-parenting is recorded

content.description:
MEASURED over all 388 children (charter D401 / S4). 66 done, 6 cancelled, 316 open. Of the 316: **269 (85%) have ZERO criteria met** — filed, never worked; 41 partial, 32 of them ONE criterion short (the merge-evidence-closable class); 7 have zero criteria at all and are unscoreable by construction; and **ZERO have all criteria met**, so dr-w19-s6's sweep left no trivially-closable residue and there is no false-OPEN.

DUPLICATION IS A ROUNDING ERROR: a Jaccard >= 0.5 title scan across all 316 open rows found exactly ONE near-duplicate pair. THE FAILURE MODE IS ABANDONMENT: filed 22/99/233/34 per day against done 4/20/42/0 — ~2.7x file-over-burn — and 254 of the 269 zeros (94%) were filed in the last three days.

TWO CONCRETE DEFECTS TO FIX BY NAME: (1) two open children are UNPUBLISHED DRAFTS — `drafts.dr-w6-s3-the-proofs-and-the-ledger-repair` (8/12) and `drafts.dr-w18-bl-boundary-continuity-gauge` (0/4) — children of the epic but invisible to `bp search` and `bp task ready`, i.e. falsely open in the strictest sense. (2) exactly ONE false-DONE exists across all 388: `dr-followup-start-reported-callers`, lifecycle done at 0/4 criteria.

THE RULING (charter D401 S4): seal is stated on the 41 PARTIALS reaching met==total or being re-scoped in writing. The 269 are RE-PARENTED to a successor epic, NEVER bulk-cancelled — cancelling them would drain the roster, and `seal-predicate.mjs:1274`'s EMPTY-ROSTER refusal exists precisely to catch that.
content.disposition_reason: Adopted by dr-backlog-never-started for ROSTER HEADROOM (charter S-4c). This row is never-started (open, zero criteria met, no claim, no assignee, no evidence), so moving it loses no work; the epic's direct roster was 450 of the seal predicate's ROSTER_PAGE_LIMIT 500, and a full page raises ROSTER-TRUNCATED and destroys the verdict. Disposition stays OPEN: this is still live, claimable work, only its parent_id moved. Nothing was cancelled.
